experiment.title: MMB Tiling Overlap
experiment.objective: Test whether tiling with overlap reduces errors in dense scenes and border-near objects while preserving the VISO evaluation protocol.

notes: Always start with devsample before any full-dataset run on VISO.
Keep seed set and evaluation protocol identical to v1 for comparability.
Single controlled variable: tiling overlap strategy.
